contents_body_check.name: contents_body_check
contents_body_check.value:
("contents"."kind" = 'markdown' and "contents"."markdown" is not null and "contents"."object_id" is null)
        or ("contents"."kind" = 'attachment' and "contents"."object_id" is not null and "contents"."markdown" is null)

installation_settings_mail_check.name: installation_settings_mail_check
installation_settings_mail_check.value: ("installation_settings"."mail_host" is null and "installation_settings"."mail_port" is null and "installation_settings"."mail_security" is null and "installation_settings"."mail_username" is null and "installation_settings"."mail_password_sealed" is null and "installation_settings"."mail_sender" is null) or coalesce((char_length("installation_settings"."mail_host") between 1 and 253 and "installation_settings"."mail_port" between 1 and 65535 and "installation_settings"."mail_security" is not null and char_length("installation_settings"."mail_sender") between 3 and 320 and ("installation_settings"."mail_username" is null or char_length("installation_settings"."mail_username") between 1 and 320) and ("installation_settings"."mail_password_sealed" is null or "installation_settings"."mail_username" is not null)), false)

installation_settings_terms_check.name: installation_settings_terms_check
installation_settings_terms_check.value: ("installation_settings"."terms_kind" is null and "installation_settings"."terms_text" is null and "installation_settings"."terms_url" is null and "installation_settings"."terms_version" is null) or coalesce((char_length("installation_settings"."terms_version") between 1 and 64 and (("installation_settings"."terms_kind" = 'text' and "installation_settings"."terms_url" is null and octet_length("installation_settings"."terms_text") between 1 and 262144) or ("installation_settings"."terms_kind" = 'address' and "installation_settings"."terms_text" is null and "installation_settings"."terms_url" ~ '^https?://' and char_length("installation_settings"."terms_url") <= 2048))), false)

installation_settings_privacy_check.name: installation_settings_privacy_check
installation_settings_privacy_check.value: ("installation_settings"."privacy_kind" is null and "installation_settings"."privacy_text" is null and "installation_settings"."privacy_url" is null and "installation_settings"."privacy_version" is null) or coalesce((char_length("installation_settings"."privacy_version") between 1 and 64 and (("installation_settings"."privacy_kind" = 'text' and "installation_settings"."privacy_url" is null and octet_length("installation_settings"."privacy_text") between 1 and 262144) or ("installation_settings"."privacy_kind" = 'address' and "installation_settings"."privacy_text" is null and "installation_settings"."privacy_url" ~ '^https?://' and char_length("installation_settings"."privacy_url") <= 2048))), false)

publication_reports_note_check.name: publication_reports_note_check
publication_reports_note_check.value: "publication_reports"."note" is null or char_length("publication_reports"."note") between 1 and 2000

publications_scope_check.name: publications_scope_check
publications_scope_check.value:
("publications"."scope_kind" = 'note' and "publications"."scope_file_id" is not null and "publications"."scope_path" is null)
        or ("publications"."scope_kind" = 'folder' and "publications"."scope_path" is not null and "publications"."scope_file_id" is null)
